title: AARYA Voice Lab Preview Generation History Record (VL-D5 §17-§20)
description: Provenance for one voice-generation run for a voice profile. Records are immutable; a regeneration always appends a new record referencing the one it supersedes via `supersedes`, so history is never silently overwritten. `recorded_at` describes the event and is never used as identity -- `record_id` is.

output_id.description: The generated PreviewArtifact's preview_id. Empty string when no artifact was produced (a BLOCKED/FAILED run).

supersedes.description: record_id of the generation this one follows, if any. Never edit a prior record -- append a new one referencing it.
